name: Sirkka Nieminen
bio:
Sirkka Nieminen's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly during her university days. While pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering, she volunteered at a local rally event and was immediately captivated by the intricate dance of engineering and raw speed. This experience ignited a passion that led her to dedicate her career to performance engineering. Over the years, she honed her skills working with various teams, from Formula Ford to GT racing, before finding her place at ART Grand Prix.

Sirkka is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis and her ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights for the drivers and the team. Her calm demeanor, even in high-pressure situations, is highly valued within the team, allowing her to make critical decisions with clarity and precision. She believes in continuous learning and actively seeks out new technologies and techniques to improve the car's performance. Sirkka's experience and dedication have made her a valuable asset to ART Grand Prix, and she is committed to helping the team achieve its competitive goals.

physical.description: Sirkka has a kind face framed by her neat grey bob.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Finnish coffee before every race.
